component.name: NovaCut
component.summary: CapCut-style video editor with a multi-track timeline and plugin marketplace

description.p: NovaCut is a video editor for Linux desktops: the fast, touch-friendly workflow of a mobile editor, with a real multi-track timeline underneath. It runs natively on Wayland and keeps the preview live while you cut.

ul.li: Magnetic timeline with separate lanes for main video, overlays, text, adjustment layers and audio
Trim handles, razor cut (S or Ctrl+B), snapping (N) and timeline zoom
Live preview canvas with 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5 project presets
Text and typography layers with fonts, colours, outlines and shadows
Speed ramping, audio waveforms, and a canvas-based smart cutout that needs no model or network access
50 transitions and 50 effects, including cinema LUTs
A plugin marketplace with declarative manifest.json filters, four presets included (Cyberpunk Neon, 80s Retro VHS, Cinematic Golden Hour, Film Noir) and an in-app filter creator

description.p: Probing, preview and export use the ffmpeg and ffprobe that ship with the freedesktop runtime, and the export dialog offers what that build supports. Speech-to-text captions are not available in this package: they need a whisper.cpp build and a Whisper model, and neither is in the project repository yet.

Projects, downloaded plugins and fonts are kept in the application's own data directory. The app reaches the network only for marketplace plugins and stock media the user asks for, and it sends no telemetry.

ul.li: Multi-track magnetic timeline with trim, razor cut and snapping
Live preview canvas with four aspect presets
Plugin marketplace and an in-app filter creator
Wayland-native window with VA-API accelerated decode
